<br>

#### **Single-cell ATAC-seq, Session 2: QC and Preprocessing**

This session covers quality control and preprocessing specific to scATAC-seq data.

* Key scATAC QC metrics: TSS enrichment, nucleosome signal, fraction of reads in peaks (FRiP) and blacklist regions
* Choosing sensible filtering thresholds
* TF-IDF normalization, and why sparse accessibility data are normalized differently from scRNA-seq
* Feature selection: choosing a peak set, re-calling peaks and consensus peak sets
